title: Club settings page: identity, logo, colours, BHPLTA identifiers
description: Admin-only settings page backed by app_settings. Covers: club display name; logo upload (replacing the default /static/st-anns-tennis.jpg and the HOME_CLUB_LOGO_PATH variable); primary and secondary colours (today literal in templates/admin/week_overview.html:13-14 and theme_color in main.go:159 and static/manifest.json); the BHPLTA club code, BHPLTA club name and BHPLTA club id used by match-card import (today the code comes from env while the name 'St+Anns' and id '10' are hardcoded in templates/admin/match_card_importation.html:330,336); the instance's public URL (consumed by WI-126). Uploaded logos are stored on the data volume, validated by type and size, and served from a dedicated path. Environment variables continue to override stored values where they exist today.

recommended_model.name: Opus 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: New admin surface with file upload handling and config precedence rules.

acceptance_criteria: An administrator can change club name, logo, both colours and the three BHPLTA identifiers from one page
Logo upload accepts PNG, JPEG or WebP only (no SVG), enforces a size limit, and stores the file on the data volume so it survives upgrades
Templates, the dynamic manifest and the service worker use the stored name, logo and colours
Match-card import posts the stored BHPLTA name and id; nothing in templates hardcodes St Ann's values
The BHPLTA identifiers are pre-filled during setup from the chosen club where they can be derived, and the page explains where to find them otherwise
Only the admin role can open or change settings

notes: Do not accept SVG uploads (script injection).
Whether BHPLTA's club id can be discovered automatically is unverified - check the club scores page markup before promising it.

testing_requirements: Handler tests for role gating and upload validation
e2e: change name and logo, see them on the week overview

context.user_story: As a club administrator, I want to set my club's name, logo and league identifiers in the app so that nothing about another club shows.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
